title: Cr2O3 Promoted In2O3 Catalysts for CO2 Hydrogenation to Methanol
extraction_notes: The provided Supporting Information pages contain only Figure S1 STEM/EDS characterization images and captions for In1.67Cr0.33O3, In0.72Cr1.28O3, In0.25Cr1.75O3, and In0.12Cr1.88O3. No experimental CO2 hydrogenation catalyst-performance data, reaction conditions, conversion/selectivity, or methanol STY values are reported in the supplied SI content.
